entries.name: James Gilbert

expected.charges: Disobedience of military orders in conscientious resistance
expected.sentence: The Civil Liberties Docket reports a 30-day sentence in December1965 and a six-month hard-labor sentence in January1966 following refusal of prisoner rehabilitation classes. A December1966 Berkeley Barb interview confirms isolation in the Treasure Island brig, transfer to another stockade, and subsequent discharge. Actual time served and the release date remain unknown.

entries.rationale: Civil Liberties Docket May1966 item125.11, PDF page68 (zero67), explicitly dates arrest December10,1965 after refusal to remove peace insignia and jacket. Original indexed text verified. No custody endpoint or sentence-derived duration inferred.

entries.name: Bernon F. Mitchell

expected.charges: Later indicted for disclosing classified National Security Agency information; no pending charge located before departure.
expected.sentence: Defected through Mexico and Cuba, publicly announced the defection in Moscow, and remained in the Soviet Union and Russia.

entries.rationale: Official NSA update reports November12,2001 death based on American consul message citing his wife. Refines existing death-based exile endpoint from year to day.

entries.name: Lowell Skinner

expected.charges: Declined repatriation to the United States after captivity in the Korean War; no criminal conviction resulted from that decision.
expected.sentence: Dishonorably discharged by the U.S. Army after refusing repatriation and permitted to leave the neutral custody area for China.

entries.rationale: AP Oregon Statesman August31,1963 p2 says Skinner returned earlier this month. UPI Hourglass August17 p3 interviews him in Akron. August1 is month placeholder, not an exact return date.
